text: Low: with baseUrl unset, /install, /install.md and /skill.md are templated from client-supplied X-Forwarded-Host/Host (leftmost value) and unescaped into HTML; reflected only to the sender unless a shared cache sits in front (CSP script-src 'self' blocks execution). Repro: repro-misc.test.ts -> evil host and raw <script> in /install. Fix: require baseUrl or validate host.
